issues: The README states a GPU memory minimum for the demo: 'Minimum VRAM for inference: 8 GB with LatentSync 1.5, 18 GB with LatentSync 1.6'. The code hard-codes cuda (scripts/inference.py:52,74; lipsync_pipeline.py:342), which the examiner's reason also notes.

Goal leaks the fix: 'The code hardcodes cuda in places, so it must be made to run on CPU (float32)'. The oracle also cut the demo to a 1.6 s clip at 5 steps without --enable_deepcache (README: inference_steps 20-50).
Even cut down, it took 41 min of the oracle budget (2486 s of 3600), and the probe agent hit the 90-minute limit (agent.timed_out=true).

previous.goal: Get LatentSync's CLI inference (python -m scripts.inference, as in inference.sh with configs/unet/stage2_512.yaml and checkpoints/latentsync_unet.pt downloaded from ByteDance/LatentSync-1.6) to produce a lip-synced video on CPU only from a short clip of assets/demo1_video.mp4 and assets/demo1_audio.wav. The code hardcodes cuda in places, so it must be made to run on CPU (float32). It must accept --video_path, --audio_path, --video_out_path, --inference_steps and --guidance_scale as in inference.sh.
